newEntry.name: Shed & Seat
newEntry.desc: Snip eight runners and seat a pierced reed in a calibrated socket handle. Alternate warp yarn through long slots and round eyes, then lift the heddle in an external loom setup. Measured sheet/socket reference, adjustable thread paths, local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL marks; connected-card, part STL and assembly ZIP. External warp, shuttle and adhesive required; weaving physically untested.
